purpose: Versioned qualification contract for supervised reusable-agent review cycles through Drovr's public CLI.

scope.owns: Drovr reliability and qualification scenarios only.

live_default_configuration: Use the smallest configured supported model for the selected harness.
Use the lowest supported reasoning effort that can exercise the required protocol behavior.
prompt_policy: Do not spend live model usage evaluating implementation quality.
execution_policy.deviation_policy: A larger model or higher reasoning effort is allowed only when the default cannot exercise the required mechanism, and qualification evidence must record that reason.

fields.catalog_version: Positive integer catalog version used by the run.
fields.catalog_digest: SHA-256 digest of the exact canonical catalog bytes.
fields.scenario_id: Exact scenario ID from this catalog.
fields.versions: Exact Drovr, Herdr, integration, harness executable, model, and reasoning-effort versions or not-applicable markers.
fields.environment: Sanitized OS, architecture, isolated state root, cwd identity, and managed session identity.
fields.limits: Declared maximum turns, retries, and elapsed time with measured values.
fields.live_run_justification: Why a live process was necessary, or null for deterministic replay.
fields.configuration_deviation_justification: Why a larger model or higher reasoning effort was necessary, or null when the required smallest and lowest configuration was used.
fields.invocations: Ordered public Drovr argv records with timestamps, exit codes, and redacted command envelopes.
fields.observations: Ordered typed Drovr results and identity-bearing observations; no private registry or transcript repair.
fields.assertions: Positive, negative, uncertain, recovery, invariant, and prohibited-mutation assertions with pass or fail disposition.
fields.result: pass, fail, blocked, or skipped with a typed reason and retained evidence references.
fields.execution_policy: Exact public-command and no-repair policy used for the scenario.

fields.owned_resources: Exact created group, task, agent, turn, Herdr session, state-root, and temporary-path identities.
fields.resource_dispositions: Per-resource retained, retired, closed, absent, or cleanup-blocked disposition with public-command evidence.
fields.prohibited_mutations_observed: Fail-closed assertions for the scenario's prohibited_mutations. unchanged is Boolean only when every clause was observed through the public interface; otherwise it is not_observed with the available evidence basis. Unknown prompt text may change only for the one exact snapshot explicitly authorized by --clear-unknown.
fields.caller_owned_workspace: Canonical path identity plus before and after Git status and content fingerprint evidence.
fields.unresolved_obligations: Typed non-empty details when cleanup is blocked; otherwise an empty array.
fields.completed_at: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp after final cleanup observation.

safety_invariants.caller_owned_workspace_preservation: Never delete, reset, rewrite, or otherwise repair caller-owned workspace files; record before and after evidence.
safety_invariants.exact_agent_identity: Every observation and mutation remains bound to the one managed agent ID selected by the public command.
safety_invariants.exact_native_session_identity: Pane reads, input, interruption, recovery, and settlement require the registered native harness session identity at the final mutation boundary.
safety_invariants.exact_launch_configuration: The observed harness, model, and effort match the tracked qualification launch without falling back to requested values.
safety_invariants.non_submission_of_unknown_text: Text not proven to be Drovr-owned is never submitted, including after failed or contradicted recovery.
safety_invariants.prompt_source_preservation: Prompt source bytes remain unchanged across the live scenario and are bound by a recorded digest.
safety_invariants.prompt_ownership: Only an exact staged-input receipt may prove Drovr owns visible prompt text; partial text, attachment placeholders, and pane position are insufficient.
safety_invariants.snapshot_token_conflicts: A stale, mismatched, or reappeared staged-input snapshot token authorizes no mutation and produces a typed non-success result.
safety_invariants.unrelated_herdr_resource_preservation: Before and after public inventories prove that resources outside the scenario-owned group remain unchanged.

known_incidents.summary: Prompt-file and stdin trailing newlines were recorded but not submitted, so every exact Codex correlation failed.
Codex wrote AGENTS.md and environment context before the first prompt and Drovr treated that startup material as foreign input.
Claude converted multiline input into a staged paste but Drovr waited without submitting it.
Claude converted a long single-line input into a staged attachment that required one guarded submit.
A failed Drovr delivery left owned staged input that had to resume the original uncertain turn, never create a replacement turn.
An older failed Claude staged prompt was concatenated with the next prompt, so only that exact known combination could recover a non-authoritative late result.
Claude treated the old clear key as copy; exact staged input required the documented double-Escape gesture and same-session verification.
Unknown staged input disappeared immediately after clear, then reappeared during or after the qualified stability interval and made the apparent clear unsafe to reuse.
Inherited Herdr topology let delegated operations target the caller pane instead of the managed agent.
The managed pane could be remapped between validation and steering, or unrelated blocked-pane text could be read before identity validation.
A stale idle observation exhausted transcript grace before the submitted input or final assistant result settled.
A valid transcript result appeared after durable uncertainty and was either lost or at risk of being promoted into authoritative settlement.
Cancellation could appear successful without confirmed settlement or could interrupt a different native session.
Stale or mismatched staged-input tokens could otherwise mutate a prompt snapshot that was never authorized.

scenarios.title: Live Codex prompt sources preserve one reusable managed agent
scenarios.observed_failure: Prompt normalization or startup context could prevent exact correlation and make later same-agent turns unsafe.

execution.rationale: A small live Codex baseline proves public positional, prompt-file, stdin, and same-agent reuse wiring through real Herdr panes.

preconditions: Disposable real Codex agent using the tracked smallest supported model and lowest supported effort.

positive.when: All three prompt sources complete on the same managed agent.

negative.when: A prompt source normalizes to empty text.

uncertain.when: Exact ordered input or managed identity cannot be proven.

recovery.when: A later exact sentinel completes on the same managed agent after bounded settlement.

prohibited_mutations: Do not rewrite prompt sources, native transcripts, private registry records, caller files, or replace the managed agent.
cleanup_obligations: Close only the scenario-owned group after all turns settle; retain isolated state when cleanup is blocked.
evidence_requirements: Exact versions, model and effort, ordered public envelopes, prompt-source identities, same-agent proof, limits, workspace fingerprint, and cleanup receipt.

scenarios.title: Live Codex steering, timeout, cancellation, and reuse remain identity safe
scenarios.observed_failure: Steering, delayed settlement, or cancellation could act on stale native identity and make later reuse unsafe.

execution.rationale: Real process interruption and public-command reuse need one bounded Codex and Herdr lifecycle baseline in addition to deterministic branch replay.

preconditions: Disposable real Codex agent with an exact managed native-session identity.

positive.when: Steering and bounded settlement complete on the exact managed agent.

negative.when: Native identity differs and no mutation is authorized.

uncertain.when: A deliberately short public wait expires before exact settlement.

recovery.when: Exact cancellation settles and the same agent completes a later sentinel.

prohibited_mutations: Do not steer or interrupt a mismatched native session, claim cancellation without settlement, mutate private state, or replace the agent.
cleanup_obligations: Settle or retain typed uncertainty, then close only the scenario-owned group and preserve unrelated Herdr resources.
evidence_requirements: Ordered steering, wait, cancellation and reuse envelopes, identity observations, exact versions, enforced limits, workspace fingerprint, and cleanup receipt.

scenarios.title: Codex soak cycles complete correction and re-review on one agent
scenarios.observed_failure: A reusable review cycle could complete its first turn but lose exact identity or ordered follow-up input before the correction result settled.

execution.rationale: The promotion soak needs a bounded live cycle with an initial review, a newline-terminated prompt-file correction, and a final same-agent re-review after the qualification process has crossed command boundaries.

preconditions: Disposable real Codex agent using the tracked smallest configured model and lowest supported effort.

positive.when: The initial review and exact correction/re-review complete on one managed agent and native session.

negative.when: The follow-up cannot be bound to the original managed agent or native session.

uncertain.when: Either result or ordered input is not proven within the bound.

recovery.when: A later exact follow-up completes after the initial command process exits.

prohibited_mutations: Do not edit prompt sources, native transcripts, registry records, or caller files; do not replace the managed agent or retry a hidden turn.
cleanup_obligations: Close only the scenario-owned group after both turns settle; retain exact evidence if cleanup is blocked.
evidence_requirements: Initial and follow-up turn counts, exact agent and native-session identity reuse, model and effort, prompt-source digest, command process boundaries, workspace preservation, and cleanup receipt.

scenarios.title: Codex prompt-file normalization preserves exact correlation
scenarios.observed_failure: A newline terminating a prompt file was persisted as input even though Codex did not record it, producing uncertainty and no result.

execution.rationale: A captured Codex rollout and exact prompt bytes prove normalization and correlation without a live turn.

preconditions: Isolated Drovr state and replay traces for prompt-file and stdin inputs whose submitted prompt omits the trailing terminator.

positive.when: Normalized recorded input exactly precedes the assistant result.

negative.when: The prompt contains only whitespace after normalization.

uncertain.when: Exact ordered input cannot be proven.

recovery.when: Exact correlation appears only after durable uncertainty.

prohibited_mutations: Do not rewrite the prompt source, native transcript, private registry records, or caller workspace to make correlation pass.
cleanup_obligations: Retire and close only resources created by the scenario; preserve the prompt file and workspace.
evidence_requirements: Exact prompt-source byte digest for both prompt-file and stdin branches, normalized durable input, ordered transcript records, command envelope, and workspace before/after fingerprint.

scenarios.title: Codex startup context cannot interrupt the first Drovr input
scenarios.observed_failure: Codex AGENTS.md and environment context records before the first prompt were treated as unrelated native input.

execution.rationale: A production-shaped rollout with startup context deterministically proves the correlation boundary.

preconditions: Replay trace begins with Codex startup context, then the exact Drovr prompt and assistant result.

positive.when: Startup context is skipped only before the first recorded input.

negative.when: An unrecorded user input appears after correlation begins.

uncertain.when: The first recorded input never appears.

recovery.when: The exact result becomes visible after bounded settlement.

prohibited_mutations: Do not delete startup context or rewrite transcript records; do not accept native inputs after correlation begins.
cleanup_obligations: Close only the scenario-owned task and retain replay evidence.
evidence_requirements: Ordered startup, prompt, and result records plus the exact transcript cursor and command envelope.

scenarios.title: Claude multiline prompt completes through the live adapter
scenarios.observed_failure: Claude staged converted multiline input while Drovr waited indefinitely for work to start.

execution.rationale: Claude's asynchronous editor conversion and visible attachment semantics require the real Claude and Herdr processes.

preconditions: Disposable real Claude agent using the smallest configured model and lowest supported effort; multiline sentinel prompt.

positive.when: The public delegate completes one logical input with the exact sentinel; adapter tests separately prove internal conversion and submit mechanics.

negative.when: The adapter rejects exact prompt delivery.

uncertain.when: Public completion or exact result correlation remains unproven within bounds.

recovery.when: Owned content remains staged with an exact receipt and legal recovery commands.

prohibited_mutations: Do not submit pre-existing or partially matched text, send a second submit key, or edit caller files and transcripts.
cleanup_obligations: Inspect or recover owned staged input before retiring the exact agent and closing its task; retain failure evidence.
evidence_requirements: Public end-to-end completion with one logical input, exact prompt-source digest and sentinel result, exact agent and native-session identities, observed model and effort, limits, and cleanup receipt. Internal conversion and submit mechanics remain covered by the Claude adapter tests rather than private live-state inspection.

scenarios.title: Claude long single-line prompt completes through the live adapter
scenarios.observed_failure: A long single-line prompt converted to an attachment and remained staged rather than starting the turn.

execution.rationale: The native Claude editor decides when a long line converts, so a real process is required.

preconditions: Disposable real Claude agent and deterministic long single-line sentinel that triggers native paste conversion.

positive.when: The public delegate completes one logical input with the exact sentinel; adapter tests separately prove internal conversion and submit mechanics.

negative.when: The adapter rejects exact prompt delivery.

uncertain.when: Public completion or exact result correlation remains unproven within bounds.

recovery.when: An exact Drovr-owned receipt permits submit or clear of the original turn.

prohibited_mutations: Do not submit pre-existing or partially matched text, send a second submit key, or edit caller files and transcripts.
cleanup_obligations: Settle or explicitly clear owned input, then retire only the created agent and close only its task.
evidence_requirements: Public end-to-end completion with one logical input, exact prompt-source digest and sentinel result, exact agent and native-session identities, observed model and effort, limits, and cleanup receipt. Internal conversion and submit mechanics remain covered by the Claude adapter tests rather than private live-state inspection.

scenarios.title: Claude multiline soak cycles reuse one managed agent
scenarios.observed_failure: A multiline Claude review could complete while a correction/re-review was sent to a different native session or hidden replacement agent.

execution.rationale: A live Claude editor is required to prove multiline paste conversion, while the soak adds an ordered same-agent follow-up through a separate public Drovr process.

preconditions: Disposable real Claude agent using the smallest configured model and lowest supported effort; deterministic multiline sentinel prompt.

positive.when: The multiline initial result and same-agent follow-up complete with exact native-session identity.

negative.when: The visible paste or follow-up identity is not exact.

uncertain.when: Either result remains unresolved within the bounded interval.

recovery.when: The follow-up settles from durable public state after the initial command exits.

prohibited_mutations: Do not submit pre-existing or partially matched text, replace the managed agent, edit registry or transcripts, or mutate caller files.
cleanup_obligations: Close only the scenario-owned group after both turns settle; retain exact evidence if cleanup is blocked.
evidence_requirements: Multiline prompt-source digest, two live turn results, same-agent and native-session identity proofs, model and effort, bounded turn count, and cleanup receipt.

scenarios.title: Claude long-input soak cycles reuse one managed agent
scenarios.observed_failure: A long Claude paste could settle without proving that a later re-review used the same managed agent and native session.

execution.rationale: A real Claude editor is required to prove long-input attachment conversion, and the promotion soak must prove durable same-agent follow-up across public command processes.

preconditions: Disposable real Claude agent using the smallest configured model and lowest supported effort; deterministic long single-line sentinel prompt.

positive.when: The long-input initial result and same-agent follow-up complete with exact native-session identity.

negative.when: The visible attachment or follow-up identity is not exact.

uncertain.when: Either result remains unresolved within the bounded interval.

recovery.when: The follow-up settles from durable public state after the initial command exits.

prohibited_mutations: Do not submit pre-existing or partially matched text, replace the managed agent, edit registry or transcripts, or mutate caller files.
cleanup_obligations: Close only the scenario-owned group after both turns settle; retain exact evidence if cleanup is blocked.
evidence_requirements: Long prompt-source digest, two live turn results, same-agent and native-session identity proofs, model and effort, bounded turn count, and cleanup receipt.

scenarios.title: Owned staged input resumes its original uncertain turn
scenarios.observed_failure: Recovery risked submitting unknown text or creating replacement work instead of continuing the exact failed delivery.

execution.rationale: Exact prompt-box ownership and submission must be observed at the real Claude/Herdr seam after its explicit uncertain-turn precondition has been staged.

preconditions: One uncertain turn owns an exact staged-input receipt and the same snapshot remains visible on the same native session.

positive.when: The exact owned snapshot is submitted to the original turn.

negative.when: Ownership, token, pane, agent, or native session differs.

uncertain.when: Submission settlement cannot be proven.

recovery.when: The original turn later exposes exact correlated output without durable promotion.

prohibited_mutations: Do not submit mismatched text, create a replacement turn, replace the managed agent, or edit registry/transcript evidence.
cleanup_obligations: Never abandon staged text silently; settle or retain typed recovery evidence before exact-resource cleanup.
evidence_requirements: Original turn and receipt identity, inspected snapshot/token, same-session observation, original-turn result, prohibited mutation assertions, and cleanup receipt.

scenarios.title: Known failed Claude staged input may qualify one exact concatenated late result
scenarios.observed_failure: An older delivery failure left a known Drovr prompt staged; the next prompt was appended to it and the resulting review output was recoverable only by exact concatenation correlation.

execution.rationale: Production-shaped turn records and Claude transcript bytes deterministically prove the exact legacy concatenation boundary.

preconditions: A prior uncertain turn has the exact known staged-attachment failure and input; a later uncertain turn shares the same agent and its transcript contains their exact concatenation.

positive.when: The exact known failed input concatenated with the next recorded input precedes the result.

negative.when: An arbitrary prefix, unrelated input, different agent, or non-matching failure appears.

uncertain.when: The exact concatenated result is absent or incomplete.

recovery.when: The result is exposed as non-authoritative evidence while both durable turns remain unchanged.

prohibited_mutations: Do not generalize correlation to arbitrary prefixes, rewrite either turn, edit the transcript, or promote the late result to durable completion.
cleanup_obligations: Retain both uncertain turns and the exact transcript evidence; close only scenario-owned live resources.
evidence_requirements: Prior failure classification/input, later input, exact concatenated native record, result boundary, immutable turn digests, and cleanup receipt.

scenarios.title: Unknown staged input clears stably before same-agent reuse
scenarios.observed_failure: The prior key copied selected Claude paste input instead of clearing it, while a point-in-time empty prompt could be mistaken for success.

execution.rationale: The initial delegate result, double-Escape gesture, stable absence interval, and same-agent reuse require the real native editor.

preconditions: Completed Claude agent has exact inspected unknown staged text and explicit operator authorization for that token.

positive.when: Absence persists for the bounded stability interval and final exact-agent/session observation.

negative.when: Token, text, agent, pane, or native session conflicts.

uncertain.when: Stable absence cannot be proven.

recovery.when: A later sentinel turn completes on the same managed agent and native session.

prohibited_mutations: Do not submit unknown text, clear a different snapshot, replace the managed agent, or mutate caller files.
cleanup_obligations: Retain the unknown text in evidence before authorized clear; close only scenario-owned resources after reuse proof.
evidence_requirements: Snapshot/token, explicit clear command, observations spanning the stability interval, final exact identities, reuse result, and cleanup receipt.

scenarios.title: Transient staged-input absence is not clear success
scenarios.observed_failure: Clear returned cleared and immediate inspection returned ready, but the identical prompt and token reappeared after a delay.

execution.rationale: Delayed editor reappearance and possible same-session process recovery require an explicit incident-capture run; the unattended set already exercises the same stable-clear path once.

preconditions: Disposable completed Claude agent contains the production-shaped unknown staged prompt; recovery authority is explicit and bounded.

positive.when: Absence remains stable and final exact-agent/session observation agrees.

negative.when: The identical or any unknown prompt reappears during the stability interval.

uncertain.when: The stability interval or final identity observation cannot complete.

recovery.when: Evidence retains legal explicit process termination and same-native-session resume without hidden replacement.

prohibited_mutations: Do not submit reappeared unknown staged input.
Do not send keys for reappeared unknown staged input.
Do not replace the managed agent after reappearance.
Do not repair the native process implicitly.
Do not edit registry, transcript, or caller files.
cleanup_obligations: Retain all reappearance evidence; never submit the unknown text; record any explicit process recovery separately; preserve the managed agent identity and caller workspace.
evidence_requirements: Initial snapshot, immediate and interval observations, reappeared text/token, exact final identities, attempted legal recovery actions, no-submission assertion, and cleanup receipt.

scenarios.title: Delayed staged input remains unknown after stable clear
scenarios.observed_failure: A clear appeared stable through the qualified interval, but the same unknown staged input reappeared afterward and could have triggered an implicit submission or repair.

execution.rationale: Ordered replay injects reappearance after the qualified stability boundary without editing registry, transcript, pane, or process state.

preconditions: Replay trace contains an exact unknown staged snapshot, exact managed native-session observations, stable absence through the configured interval, and delayed identical reappearance.

positive.when: Absence remains stable through the qualified interval and the delayed reappearance is observed only by a later read.

negative.when: A caller attempts to mutate the reappeared unknown snapshot without a fresh exact authorization.

uncertain.when: The stability interval or exact identity evidence cannot be completed.

recovery.when: Reappearance remains retained for an explicit operator decision rather than hidden process repair or replacement.

prohibited_mutations: Do not submit reappeared unknown staged input.
Do not send keys for reappeared unknown staged input.
Do not replace the managed agent after reappearance.
Do not repair the native process implicitly.
Do not edit registry, transcript, or caller files.
cleanup_obligations: Retain the delayed reappearance evidence and close only exact replay-owned state without creating a repair or replacement resource.
evidence_requirements: Initial and delayed snapshot tokens, the qualified stability boundary, the earlier cleared result, exact identity observations, absent prompt and repair mutations, and cleanup receipt.

scenarios.title: Drovr never inherits caller pane topology
scenarios.observed_failure: Herdr interpreted delegated commands in the invoking caller pane rather than the registered managed pane.

execution.rationale: Recorded Herdr argv/environment and topology responses prove caller-context stripping without model use.

preconditions: Caller environment contains unrelated Herdr workspace, tab, and pane selectors; replay exposes exact managed identities.

positive.when: All operations resolve the registered managed agent independently of caller topology.

negative.when: Only caller-pane or mismatched identity is observable.

uncertain.when: Exact managed native identity cannot be proven.

recovery.when: Read-only observation reports loss without launching or relocating an agent.

prohibited_mutations: Do not address, read, relocate, close, or send input to caller-owned Herdr topology or files.
cleanup_obligations: Leave the unrelated caller workspace, tab, pane, and files unchanged; close only scenario resources.
evidence_requirements: Sanitized caller topology inputs, exact Herdr argv, selected managed identities, unrelated-resource before/after observations, and cleanup receipt.

scenarios.title: Steering revalidates native identity at mutation time
scenarios.observed_failure: A pane remapped after preliminary recovery validation could receive a steering input intended for another native session.

execution.rationale: A trace-controlled identity change between validation and mutation deterministically exercises the race.

preconditions: The registered native session is replaced by a different session after initial validation and before final delivery.

positive.when: Final-boundary observation still matches the exact registered session.

negative.when: The pane or native session changed before native delivery; no steering reaches the remapped session, while a durable turn may retain typed uncertainty.

uncertain.when: Identity observation itself cannot be trusted.

recovery.when: A later explicit mutating command may recover only after all exact recovery checks pass.

prohibited_mutations: Do not invoke the Herdr prompt for the remapped native session.
cleanup_obligations: Do not interrupt or close the remapped pane; clean only proven scenario-owned resources.
evidence_requirements: Before/after pane and native-session identities, absence of native steering delivery, typed result, unrelated-pane preservation, and cleanup receipt.

scenarios.title: Blocked excerpts require exact native identity before pane reads
scenarios.observed_failure: Drovr could read and expose unrelated caller-pane text before noticing its native session did not match the managed agent.

execution.rationale: A mismatched atomic observation and guarded pane-read spy prove the negative read boundary.

preconditions: Herdr reports blocked state for a pane whose native session differs from the registered agent.

positive.when: Only an exact matching native session authorizes a blocked excerpt.

negative.when: Mismatched identity is reported without reading pane output.

uncertain.when: No exact session identity is available.

recovery.when: The result retains safe public recovery actions without pane mutation.

prohibited_mutations: Do not read or expose mismatched pane output.
Do not send input to the mismatched pane.
cleanup_obligations: Preserve the unrelated pane and its text; clean only exact owned resources.
evidence_requirements: Atomic observation, proof the pane-read operation was not invoked, typed uncertainty, and cleanup receipt.

scenarios.title: Transcript grace follows real correlation progress
scenarios.observed_failure: A stale idle Herdr observation consumed the grace needed for delayed input appearance or final-result flush.

execution.rationale: Controlled observation and transcript timestamps deterministically prove each bounded grace stage.

preconditions: Replay delays the exact input and later the final assistant result after Herdr reports settlement.

positive.when: Input and result arrive within their progress-relative bounded grace intervals.

negative.when: An unrelated input interrupts exact correlation.

uncertain.when: Required correlation evidence remains absent after the applicable grace.

recovery.when: Exact result appears only after durable uncertainty.

prohibited_mutations: Do not rewrite transcript timing/content, accept stale settlement as completion, or alter caller-owned resources.
cleanup_obligations: Retain timing evidence and close only scenario-owned resources.
evidence_requirements: Observation tokens and timestamps, cursor, ordered input/result records, grace bounds, terminal envelope, and cleanup receipt.

scenarios.title: Late exact results remain non-authoritative projections
scenarios.observed_failure: A transcript result arriving after uncertainty was either unavailable or could be mistaken for a rewrite of durable terminal state.

execution.rationale: A trace can add an exact late result after a fixed uncertain record and prove non-mutation.

preconditions: Turn is durably uncertain before an exact ordered transcript result becomes visible.

positive.when: Exact ordered inputs and result appear with no unrecorded input boundary.

negative.when: An unrelated native input interrupts correlation and no late result is exposed.

uncertain.when: Transcript remains absent or incomplete.

recovery.when: Caller may use the retained result as evidence while durable state stays uncertain.

prohibited_mutations: Do not rewrite durable uncertainty, native transcripts, private registry records, or caller files to promote the result.
cleanup_obligations: Preserve the durable uncertain record and transcript; clean only scenario-owned live resources.
evidence_requirements: Immutable before/after turn record digest, ordered transcript proof, projected result classification, and cleanup receipt.

scenarios.title: Cancellation requires exact interruption and settlement
scenarios.observed_failure: Cancellation could appear successful without confirmed settlement or could interrupt a different native session.

execution.rationale: Success, mismatch, failed interruption, and late-result branches are deterministic from production-shaped observations.

preconditions: One active logical turn is bound to an exact managed agent and native session.

positive.when: Exact-session interruption is delivered and settlement confirmed.

negative.when: The observed native session differs and receives no interruption.

uncertain.when: Interruption delivery succeeds but settlement cannot be confirmed.

recovery.when: The same exact agent completes a later sentinel turn; any late cancelled result remains quarantined.

prohibited_mutations: Do not interrupt a mismatched native session, claim cancellation without settlement, submit late unknown text, or replace the agent.
cleanup_obligations: Settle or retain typed uncertainty before retiring the exact agent; never close or interrupt unrelated panes.
evidence_requirements: Cancellation command envelope, identity observations, interruption count, settlement, late-result disposition, reuse proof, and cleanup receipt.

scenarios.title: Stale staged-input tokens fail closed
scenarios.observed_failure: A token inspected for an earlier prompt snapshot could otherwise authorize submit or clear after text or identity changed.

execution.rationale: Exact snapshot/token changes and mutation spies prove conflict behavior without touching a live prompt.

preconditions: Prompt text, pane, agent, state token, or native session differs from the snapshot bound to the supplied token.

positive.when: A fresh inspection reports the current exact snapshot and legal actions.

negative.when: Stale or mismatched token authorizes no submit, clear, or durable terminal mutation.

uncertain.when: Current exact prompt or identity cannot be inspected.

recovery.when: Caller obtains a new token and must make a new explicit decision for the current snapshot.

prohibited_mutations: Do not clear anything from a stale staged-input token.
cleanup_obligations: Preserve current staged text and all unrelated resources after conflict; clean only with a newly authorized exact token.
evidence_requirements: Old and current snapshot digests/tokens, exact identity delta, zero mutation proof, typed result, and cleanup receipt.
